OfflineArchiveTransferHelp: Fetches one compressed archive per series instead of one request per image. This is usually much faster over slow or high-latency connections. The copy stored on this device is the same either way.
OfflineArchiveTransferLabel: Transfer offline copies as per-series archives
OfflineArchiveTransferSavedOff: Offline copies will be transferred one image at a time. Transfers already in progress are not affected.
OfflineArchiveTransferSavedOn: Offline copies will be transferred as one archive per series. Transfers already in progress are not affected.
OfflineRetryAttemptsHelp: How many times a single image is requested before it is reported as failed. Higher values ride out brief network problems at the cost of a slower report when something is genuinely wrong. Applies to the next transfer you start.
OfflineRetryAttemptsLabel: Attempts per image before it counts as failed (1-5)
